message: 魔性の女達

name: Melilot
message: 「Two thousand and forty-five, two thousand and forty-six, two thousand and forty-seven, two thousand and four--」

name: Melilot
message: 「--five hundred and twenty-three, five hundred and twenty-four...」

name: Melilot
message: 「I see... So this is one of the seams. Surprisingly shoddy, isn't it. With phrasing of this caliber, breaking the curse will be trivial...」

name: Melilot
message: 「Mmh... A lovely night breeze」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya-ha! I took down the intruder!! Nyapupupu, Bylous-nyama is gonna praise me, nya」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyanu? Why aren't you knocked out cold, nya?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Nighttime is the hour of slumber that visits all beings...」

name: Melilot
message: 「A gentle breeze of tranquility is quite pleasant, yet a gust from an uncouth cat is simply unacceptable」

name: Pasta
message: 「Quit talking nonsense, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Allow me to explain simply. Although I evaded your ambush, the gust of wind left roughly three strands of my bangs with split ends. I demand atonement」

name: Pasta
message: 「Y-You're using big fancy words, but basically you're making fun of me, nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Aah, did you just laugh, nya? Then you're an enemy, nya, here to smash up our precious magic circle, nya?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Anyone who gets in our way gets slaughtered, nya. I don't like you, so I'm gonna torture you to death, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am not reluctant to fight, yet you are far too reckless, Miss Wheat Flour」

name: Pasta
message: 「Who's Miss Wheat Flour, nya?! Pasta is Pasta, nya! Prepare yourself, nya!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaryaaaaah!!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Choosing to enter battle was your mistake」

name: Pasta
message: 「N-No way, nya... Getting torn to shreds in an instant, nya... P-Pasta doesn't lose to anyone in speed, nya...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Indeed, in an advantageous battle, specialized abilities alone tend to prove useful, easily creating the illusion that they hold true value」

name: Melilot
message: 「However, in the grand scheme, deploying troops is no different from a mass game. The fundamental requirement is resilience... and you lack it」

name: Pasta
message: 「Shut up, nya! Pasta can still fight, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「If you take a fighting stance once more, every bone in your body will shatter, you know? I arranged it that way」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nya... Nya, that's a lie, nya!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Whether you believe it or not is up to you. Will you retreat for now to recuperate, or march straight to your own destruction--」

name: Pasta
message: 「F-For Bylous-nyama-nyama, Pasta wouldn't regret giving up her life, nya...!」

name: Melilot
message: 「Can you not even tell friend from foe, you greenhorn!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyahin!」
「Hehe... We finally meet.」

name: Pasta
message: 「S-Soltia」

name: Soltia
message: 「Rather than the front gate, someone has been planting cracks into the magic circle from the back door. Cleverly so as not to be noticed, yet set as a surefire trap to shatter it.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I thought it might be the Nive Clan, so I came to see who it was... Still a bit naive, aren't you?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Soltia, you came at just the right time, nya! Beat this woman to a pulp for me, nya!」

name: Soltia
message: 「I have no obligation to listen to your requests.」

name: Pasta
message: 「N-No way, nya~」

name: Soltia
message: 「Take the salt your enemy is offering you for once, and withdraw like a good girl.」

name: Pasta
message: 「Uuu~, Pasta is going home to sulk in bed, nya!」

name: Soltia
message: 「...Now we're finally alone.」

name: Melilot
message: 「I am not particularly pleased about it--Soltia.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Impressive... So you realized my true identity.」

name: Melilot
message: 「And so, have you come to take Pasta's place and spring my trap?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Don't be so on guard. I haven't the slightest intention of fighting you.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Then what have you come here to do?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Come here? Or come to the Human World?」

name: Melilot
message: 「Both... However, what I urgently wish to ask about is the latter. Your reason for remaining in this world with Re-Crea looming ahead.」

name: Soltia
message: 「What if this Re-Crea also encompasses a cataclysm? And what if a power that immense is something that can be perceived?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Whether you believe me or not is entirely up to you, Melilot」

name: Melilot
message: 「...That is truly fascinating. Might I ask you to tell me more about it?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hehehe, by the way, Melilot, I hear the black tea you brew is simply divine」

name: Melilot
message: 「Please come by the library. I shall brew some tea for you in the librarian's office」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'd love that」
